inventory.visualPurpose: The receiver operating characteristic curve figure (book 261): the plot that demonstrates how well a diagnostic test can distinguish between 2 groups (eg, disease vs healthy) — TP rate (sensitivity) vs FP rate (1 – specificity), with the chance diagonal, the ideal-test corner, the actual-test curve, and the AUC comparison rule for ranking tests
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: PURE VECTOR LINE ART, no raster (pdfimages: zero raster images; geometry pinned by the raw text layer + a PyMuPDF vector trace — exact stroke colors, dash patterns, bezier control points, span colors, per-character rotation vectors — + a 3-pass VLM read: full page 120dpi + two 200dpi crops, staging-pubh9/vlm-census.txt): a square plot with the y-axis label 'TP rate (sensitivity)' printed ROTATED 90° (reading bottom-to-top) and the x-axis label 'FP rate (1 – speciﬁcity)' horizontal below (fi ligature as printed); a '1' at the top of the y-axis and a '1' at the right end of the x-axis as the ONLY axis numbers (small tan vector tick marks at both ends; no origin '0', no '.5' ticks); the region above the diagonal shaded light lavender (#f1e6f2) and below it light blue (#e7f6fd); THREE traces — the chance DIAGONAL (blue #4d7cbe, dashed 6-3, origin to top-right corner) labeled 'No predictive value (AUC = 0.5)' (blue #4d7cbe, printed rotated ~42° running parallel above the diagonal; PyMuPDF reads it as one span, direction (0.741, −0.671)); the IDEAL TEST trace (pink/mauve #c978a1, dashed 6-3 — rising vertically up the left edge from the origin, rounding the corner, running along the top to (1,1)) labeled 'Ideal test (AUC = 1)' (pink #c978a1, horizontal, at the top of the plot); and the ACTUAL TEST curve (gray #939598, solid 1.5pt, two bezier segments — steep rise hugging the left, then flattening along the top to (1,1), concave toward the upper-left corner) labeled 'Actual test (0.5 < AUC < 1)' (dark gray #6d6e71, typeset on a CURVED baseline along the curve with per-character rotation from ~74° to ~32° — the reason the text layer shatters it into the jumbled fragments 'Act/ua/l te/s' + 't (0/.5/</UC/<A/1)'); a small double-headed dark-gray arrow (#6d6e71, two collinear 45° shafts with filled heads) printed in the wedge between the ideal trace and the actual curve; the axes tan #a69a84 with NO arrowheads; a tiny slate-blue Rx-style vector icon at the figure's lower right (decorative, not redrawn).
inventory.kypLocation: Zone A of the registry visual (RocPrecisionMap in visuals/pubhealth-p9.tsx): the plane redrawn with the two printed axis labels (horizontal text — the print rotates the y-axis label 90°), the printed two-'1' axis numbering plus documented 0/.5/1 ticks, the dashed chance diagonal, the dashed ideal corner trace, the solid actual-test curve bowing toward the upper left corner, the shaded area under the curve as the AUC, all three printed trace labels as horizontal text with leader lines, the one-cutoff dot, the labeled AUC-gap arrow (the print's double-headed annotation, KYP-labeled), the how-to-read panel (both printed body sentences quoted verbatim + the KYP readings), and the comparison-rule chip; the figure's semantics are also carried in mechanisms[0] auc-geometry, blocks[1] the verbatim text block, blocks[3] the decoder list (LANDMARKS 1–5), and recall[0-2]

inventory.visualPurpose: The precision-vs-accuracy four-target figure (book 261): the dartboard panel that summarizes the 2×2 of precision (reliability — consistency and reproducibility, destroyed by random error) × accuracy (validity — closeness to the true values, destroyed by systematic error or bias), with all four combinations drawn
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: PURE VECTOR LINE ART, no raster (pdfimages: zero raster images; geometry pinned by the raw text layer + a PyMuPDF vector trace + the 200dpi VLM crop pass, staging-pubh9/vlm-census.txt): FOUR targets printed in ONE horizontal row as TWO pairs — the word 'Accuracy' prints TWICE above (centered over each pair, in 8pt MuseoSansCond-300) with tan/olive bracket connector lines (#b8ae9a) dropping to a High/Low word positioned over EACH target (High over the left target, Low over the right, within both pairs), and the word 'Precision' prints TWICE below with mirrored brackets rising to a High/Low word under each target (the LEFT pair both High, the RIGHT pair both Low). Each target is three concentric filled circles (pale tan #e6e0d9 outer r≈35, darker tan #d5ccc1 middle r≈21.5, olive #b8ae9a bullseye r≈7) with FIVE teal dart dots (#3a899b, r≈3.5): target 1 — tight cluster centered on the bullseye; target 2 — tight cluster off-center to the upper left (bullseye empty, cluster at the ring's edge); target 3 — scattered widely but distributed around the center; target 4 — scattered AND off to the upper left. So all four accuracy × precision combinations are present, each target carrying one accuracy word above and one precision word below. The block's text sub-blocks print alongside: 'Precision (reliability)' with First Aid's OWN red letters (the 're' of Precision and of reliability, #c04d49; the red-bold 're' of 'reproducibility' in the first definition line, #b82837) and 'Accuracy (validity)' with the red 'A'/'a' — PyMuPDF span colors. The raw text layer interleaves the two label groups and interleaves the indd footer slug mid-figure (documented quirks).
inventory.kypLocation: Zone B of the registry visual (RocPrecisionMap in visuals/pubhealth-p9.tsx): the print's one-row-of-two-pairs arrangement re-drawn as a TRUE 2×2 matrix — accuracy High/Low columns (the ACCURACY (VALIDITY) super-header with the printed definition lines and the systematic-error annotation) × precision High/Low rows (the PRECISION (RELIABILITY) label column with the High/Low chips, the random-error annotation, and the KYP tight/centered hook) — each cell a three-ring target with five darts in the printed pattern plus a caption card naming the combination and its error family, with the printed definition and arrow lines carried verbatim in the bottom strip ('Random error ↓ precision in a test.' / '↑ precision → ↓ standard deviation.' / '↑ precision → ↑ statistical power (1 − β).' / 'Systematic error ↓ accuracy in a test.'); the panel's semantics are also carried in mechanisms[1] error-type-split, blocks[2] the verbatim table block, blocks[5] the compare block, and recall[3-7]

notes: The page carries TWO visual assets, both pure-vector figures (pdfimages: zero rasters) — the ROC curve figure (sv1: TP rate (sensitivity) vs FP rate (1 – specificity), the dashed chance diagonal labeled 'No predictive value (AUC = 0.5)', the dashed pink ideal corner trace labeled 'Ideal test (AUC = 1)', the solid gray actual-test curve labeled 'Actual test (0.5 < AUC < 1)' bowing toward the upper left corner, two '1's as the only axis numbers) and the precision/accuracy four-target panel (sv2: four three-ring targets with five teal darts each — tight+centered, tight+off-center, scattered+centered, scattered+off-center — 'Accuracy' printed twice above with per-target High/Low words, 'Precision' twice below) — BOTH accounted for as ORIGINAL_KYP_REDRAW records implemented together in ONE registry visual (roc-precision-map, RocPrecisionMap in visuals/pubhealth-p9.tsx, viewBox 0 0 1102 1180): Zone A redraws the ROC plane (horizontal-text label redraws of the print's rotated/curved labels, documented 0/.5/1 ticks, the shaded AUC, the one-cutoff dot, the labeled AUC-gap arrow, the printed comparison rule) and Zone B re-arranges the print's one-row-of-two-pairs panel as a TRUE 2×2 of accuracy columns × precision rows with per-cell error chips and the printed definition/arrow lines strip; nothing is reproduced, and both text blocks are additionally carried verbatim in the note (blocks[1] text block, blocks[2] table block).
